onboarding.title: Welcome to Cap Emploi
onboarding.intro: Three settings to tailor the tool to your search. You can change everything later in your profile.
onboarding.trade: The fields you are aiming for
onboarding.tradeHint: Pick several: your experience carries over to other fields. The first one ticked is used for message templates.

general.name: All fields
general.desc: General sectors and messages, valid for any role.
general.skills: Team management, budget and P&L ownership, service mindset, organisation and languages.

hospitality.name: Hospitality and catering
hospitality.desc: Hotels, restaurants, hotel groups, casinos, caterers.
hospitality.skills: Your core field: operations, rooms, food and beverage, revenue, service quality and leadership.

events.name: Events
events.desc: Agencies, venues, conventions, trade fairs, festivals.
events.skills: Banqueting and meetings, supplier coordination, handling the unexpected on the day, demanding clients.

operations.name: Operations management
operations.desc: Running sites or services: contract catering, leisure, business services.
operations.skills: Running a 24/7 site: rostering, KPIs, P&L, multi-department teams and service continuity.

facility.name: Facility management
facility.desc: Workplace services, front desk, cleaning, maintenance, headquarters and institutions.
facility.skills: Building maintenance, subcontractors (cleaning, security, catering), service contracts and occupant experience.

property.name: Real estate and property management
property.desc: Building management, serviced residences, offices, shopping centres.
property.skills: Day-to-day running of a property: upkeep, budgets, resident or tenant relations, added services.

customer.name: Customer service and experience
customer.desc: Private banking, airlines, premium cars, insurance, concierge services.
customer.skills: Premium service culture, complaint handling, loyalty, satisfaction measurement and front-line training.

luxury_retail.name: Luxury retail
luxury_retail.desc: Fashion, jewellery, watches, department stores, wines and spirits.
luxury_retail.skills: Demanding international clientele, luxury codes, sales team leadership and revenue targets.

purchasing.name: Purchasing and procurement
purchasing.desc: Food and general purchasing, contract catering, distribution.
purchasing.skills: Supplier negotiation, food cost, stock and tenders, learned running a hotel and its restaurants.

quality.name: Quality, hygiene and safety
quality.desc: Quality, HACCP, health and safety, audit and certification.
quality.skills: Brand standards, HACCP, audits and mystery visits, action plans, guest and staff safety.

project.name: Project management
project.skills: Openings and renovations, launching new services, coordinating many stakeholders against tight deadlines.

health_seniors.name: Health care and senior living
health_seniors.desc: Senior residences, care homes, hospital hospitality services.
health_seniors.skills: Accommodation, catering and welcome serving residents, care for people, team management and compliance.

consulting.name: Consulting, training and interim
consulting.desc: Interim management, consulting, training, hospitality schools.
consulting.skills: Years of experience to pass on: turning a property around, training teams, auditing and advising. Assignments that look for experienced profiles.

profile.accountIntro: Your data is hosted in the European Union. You can download it or delete your account at any time.
profile.deleteLabel: To permanently delete your account and all your data, type {word}
profile.tradesHint: Tick every field you are interested in: they shape sources, search ideas and opportunities.
profile.skillsIntro: What a hospitality background brings to each target field. Check that your profile shows it with facts and figures.

senior.label: Put my experience forward (experienced profile)
senior.hint: Your CVs show no age, date of birth or photo; roles older than 15 years are summarised in one line; letters and opportunities present your experience as an asset and also point you to employers looking for experienced profiles. Nothing is hidden or invented: everything stays in your profile.
senior.law: In Luxembourg, the law prohibits age discrimination in hiring (law of 28 November 2006 on equal treatment).

who.p: Cap Emploi is published by Yorrick Pellegri, Luxembourg. This is a launch version, to be reviewed before opening to the public.

data.p: Email address, encrypted password, candidate profile and CV, targets and notes, weekly counters and generated documents. They are used only to run your space.

ai.p: To produce your documents, your profile and the job ad are sent to Anthropic’s Claude model through a server function. They are only used to produce your documents and are not used to train the model.

where.p: Accounts and database are hosted by Supabase in the European Union. Each user can only access their own data, enforced by database-level security rules.

rights.p: From your profile you can download all your data or delete your account, which permanently erases all of your data.

contact.p: For any question about your data, write to the project owner.

mail.p: If you check your Gmail or Outlook alerts, access is read-only, from your browser and only while checking. Only emails from job sites over the last 14 days are read and sent to the AI to extract the offers; only the offers are kept.
